status: Independent D8 participation/growth scenario, not a continuation of observed runtime activity. Same R17 metadata as D5/D6; no current Board metrics or historical snapshots are claimed.

resource.byteMetric: D5 current decoded live value-payload bytes, including stored framework/causal/captured-result values; not physical storage.

participation.metric: Unique currently disclosed PIDs with a recorded association to R17, deduplicated across names.
participation.coverage: Synthetic complete disclosed set for this comparison only; one association per PID in this fixture.
participation.note: Layouts repeat the same R17 and same five groups as alternatives, not extra resources. Group shapes/seats do not encode capacity or exact membership. Future byte cases hold this association population fixed.

history.basis: Synthetic observed samples, not current API history.
history.missingIntervals: No intermediate observations asserted. Do not infer source ages, linear historical growth or available historical values.

scenario.conventions: Elapsed days: month=30, year=365, decade=3650; not calendar arithmetic.
assumptions: Rates are chosen illustrative net changes, not fitted to the historical samples.
No probabilities or confidence intervals are attached to low/steady/high cases.
No topology, participation, schema, policy or deployment change is modeled.
Values are conditional arithmetic, not future records or an instruction to retain/delete data.

planning.budgetKind: Illustrative user planning assumption, not an enforced quota, measured capacity or physical disk budget.

currentValueBudget.assessment: Beyond planning limit in the steady year case
